invoicing_requirements_summary: Obtain official UWE PO before supplying, quote valid PO on invoice. PDF invoices one invoice per PDF and separate attachment. Required unique invoice number, issue date, PO, supplier business name/address/contact, UWE name/address/contact person, separate net/VAT/gross amounts, clear description, bank details, VAT registration if registered and company number if limited. Standard 30 days from correctly rendered invoice date, weekly BACS payments. June 2025 terms require goods invoices after all delivery and services after completion, supporting information including PO, GBP unless other currency pre-agreed, quantity/unit-price/amount match PO and invoice dispatched same day as dated. VAT paid against valid VAT invoice. Email-free suppliers may post invoices/statements to AP address. Statements use accounts.payable and invoice payment queries use paymentqueries. No e-invoicing or supply-chain finance available, no supplier-list deductions. Corrected undisputed invoice required when part disputed. Visitor expenses also weekly BACS.
